description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of various language models on the November 2024 AMC-10 and AMC-12 mathematics tests, with scores normalized to a maximum of 150 and computed over 100 runs at a sampling temperature of t=0.5. The horizontal axis lists 10 models, ordered from left to right as: Llama-3.3 70B Instruct, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Qwen 2.5 14B-Instruct, GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Qwen 2.5 72B-Instruct, Gemini Flash 1.5, Gemini Pro 1.5, and phi-4. The vertical axis represents the average score, ranging from 60 to 90 in increments of 10. Two bar colors distinguish model sizes: light blue for “Large model” and dark blue for “Small model,” as indicated in the legend. Each bar includes error bars representing ±2 standard errors of the mean. Phi-4 (small model) achieves the highest score at 91.8, followed closely by Gemini Pro 1.5 (large model) at 89.8. Other notable scores include GPT-4o-mini (78.2), GPT-4o (77.9), and Claude 3.5 Sonnet (74.8). Llama-3.3 70B Instruct (large model) scores lowest at 66.4. The chart visually emphasizes phi-4’s strong performance relative to both larger and similarly sized models, supporting the caption’s claim that it performs well above its “weight-class” in competition math.
